1.0.title: Motionary 1.0
1.0.subtitle: First public release
features: Multitrack editing for video, audio, and text
Add a new dimension to your edits with haptics.

sections.title: Share a project
sections.body: Send an editable .mpj file via Share Project in the project menu to let others continue your work in Motionary.

sections.title: Bugs and ideas
sections.body: Shake to send feedback, or go to Settings → Feedback. If reporting a bug, briefly describe what happened.
